title: Clutch Lending Data Export record
description: Daily export of consumer loan origination sessions and applications, one row per funnel record. Derived from the published Clutch data dictionary at https://support.withclutch.com/support/solutions/articles/153000248797-data-exports-lending

session_id.description: String: an ID representing a unique user session. A session lasts up to 4 hours, or ends after 15 minutes of inactivity.

application_id.description: String: an ID representing a unique application sent to the LOS.

user_id.description: String: a UUID representing a unique user (the main applicant).

applicant_name.description: String: the main applicant's full name.

applicant_email.description: String: the main applicant's email address.

user_phone.description: Number: the main applicant's phone number.

user_fico_score_range.description: String: the range in which the main applicant's FICO score falls.

user_income_range.description: String: the range in which the main applicant's self-declared annual income falls.

applicant_zip_code.description: String: the main applicant's zip code.

applicant_employer.description: String: the main applicant's employer name.

applicant_job_title.description: String: the main applicant's job title.

application_category.description: String: the loan type the user applied for. Null if the application was dropped before selection.

credit_structure.description: String: whether the application is for a loan or a line of credit.

application_mode.description: String: whether the application is new or a refinance of an existing deal.

collateral_type.description: String: the kind of collateral being used. Null if none.

application_nr.description: Number: the loan number in the LOS.

application_amnt.description: Number: the amount the user applied for.

experience_started_at.description: Timestamp: date and time when the application started.

user_authenticated_at.description: Timestamp: date and time when the user authenticated in the portal. Null if they didn't.

application_started_at.description: Timestamp: date and time when the user selected an application category. Null if they didn't.

application_submitted_at.description: Timestamp: date and time when the user submitted the application. Null if they didn't.

application_confirmed_at.description: Timestamp: date and time when the LOS received the application. Null if it didn't.

record_last_updated_at.description: Timestamp: date and time when this record was last updated.

utm_source.description: String: part of the URL used for tracking (must be present in the Clutch URL).

utm_medium.description: String: part of the URL used for tracking (must be present in the Clutch URL).

utm_campaign.description: String: part of the URL used for tracking (must be present in the Clutch URL).

utm_content.description: String: part of the URL used for tracking (must be present in the Clutch URL).

utm_term.description: String: part of the URL used for tracking (must be present in the Clutch URL).

accepted_tcpa_at.description: Timestamp: date and time when the applicant accepted TCPA disclaimers.

zest_score.description: Number: the main applicant's Zest score for that application.

chance_of_approval_badge.description: String: the badge shown to the applicant while browsing that offer. Possible values:; HIGH; LOW; MEDIUM; NOT_ENOUGH_INFORMATION

gap_offered.description: Boolean: whether the user was offered the opportunity to express interest in GAP (protection product).

gap_selected.description: Boolean: whether the user expressed interest in GAP (protection product).

mp_offered.description: Boolean: whether the user was offered the opportunity to express interest in mechanical breakdown protection.

mp_selected.description: Boolean: whether the user expressed interest in mechanical breakdown protection.

pp_offered.description: Boolean: whether the user was offered the opportunity to express interest in payment protection.

pp_selected.description: Boolean: whether the user expressed interest in payment protection.

member_nr.description: Number: the main applicant's member number.

referral_source.description: String: the referral source defined in the application's URL. Matches what's sent to the LOS.

origin_module.description: String: the origin of the application. Possible values:; LENDING; ACCOUNT OPENINGThis enables calculating cross-sell from account opening to lending.

fraud_check_application_id.description: String: an identifier for the fraud check application. Can be null.

fraud_check_entity_token.description: String: an identifier for the fraud check token. Can be null.

gclid.description: String: Google click identifier, used in the URL for tracking purposes. Can be null.

disclosure_acknowledged_at.description: Timestamp: date and time when the applicant accepted product-specific disclaimers (credit cards and home equity).

automobile_estimated_list_price.description: Number: for vehicle loans, the estimated list price of the vehicle.

events_funnel_id.description: String: a UUID representing a unique record in the export. This is the primary key for the table.

application_origin.description: String: the application's origin. Possible values:; original; loan_cross_sell; deposit_cross_sell; remarketing

device_id.description: String: unique identifier for the device used to start the application session.

authentication_method.description: String: the method used to authenticate the session that started the application. Possible values: sso, password.

gap_quote.description: Decimal: the GAP (Guaranteed Asset Protection) insurance premium amount quoted to the customer, in dollars.

mp_quote.description: Decimal: the Mechanical Protection insurance premium amount quoted to the customer, in dollars.

pp_quote.description: Decimal: the Payment Protection insurance premium amount quoted to the customer, in dollars.

gap_plan.description: String: the GAP plan name/description from the LOS.

mp_plan.description: String: the Mechanical Protection plan name/description from the LOS.

pp_plan.description: String: the Payment Protection plan name/description from the LOS.
